notes: ollama.min is the floor the stack needs (0.40.13, owner 2026-11-01); hosts follow the current release from latest_from and are never pinned (RealityEngine_CI#663). MLX-supported models run on MLX from 0.40.0, and the MLX build of the universe model from 0.40.5. The OpenClaw gateway runs natively (RealityEngine_CI#592), so a missing OpenClaw, or one on a Node other than node.exact, fails install. The constants in release/realityengine are checked against this file by scripts/tests/test-host-preflight.sh.
